reasoning: Read both setup paths. FixRX::setup_pre_force (src/DPD-REACT/fix_rx.cpp:551-558) runs an UNCONDITIONAL loop 'for (int id = 0; id < nlocal; id++) for (int ispecies...) { ... atom->dvector[atom_ind_old][id] = tmp; }' over every local atom, and only then restricts the zero-rate ODE with 'for (int i = 0; i < nlocal; i++) if (mask[i] & groupbit)' (:560-571). FixRxKokkos<DeviceType>::setup_pre_force (fix_rx_kokkos.cpp:1227-1233) does nothing but 'this->solve_reactions(vflag,false)', and the only place the KOKKOS port writes ConcOld in that path is Tag_FixRxKokkos_solveSystems<ZERO_RATES>, whose entire body is inside 'if (d_mask(i) & groupbit)' (line 1262), with 'd_dvector(atom_ind_old, i) = static_cast<KK_FLOAT>(tmp);' at line ~1297. Checked the obvious refutation -- that the CPU's per-atom solvers already do this so the extra loop is redundant -- and it does not hold: the CPU's ConcOld updates inside rk4 (fix_rx.cpp:831-835) and rkf45 (:1273-1276) are themselves reached only for in-group atoms, exactly like the KOKKOS kernel. The unconditional setup loop is genuinely the only place out-of-group atoms get ConcOld initialized, and the KOKKOS port has no equivalent. Only bites when fix rx is given a group other than 'all'.
fix: In FixRxKokkos::setup_pre_force (or at the top of the ZERO_RATES branch of solve_reactions), add a parallel_for over [0,nlocal) with no groupbit test that copies 'd_dvector(d_species_ind_to_atom_prop_ind_old(ispecies), i) = d_dvector(d_species_ind_to_atom_prop_ind(ispecies), i)' for every species, mirroring fix_rx.cpp:551-558, before dispatching the zero-rate solve.
